articles.headline: UEFA awaits FIFA answers to Gianni Infantino queries as deadline looms - report
articles.description: UEFA is still waiting to receive answers to a series of questions it posed to FIFA related to Gianni Infantino's presidency, with only hours to go until the deadline for a response passes.

articles.headline: Two-time WC coach Okada leaves Japan post over AFC support of Infantino
articles.description: Two-time World Cup coach Takeshi Okada resigned as Japanese federation VP in protest over AFC support of FIFA during Gianni Infantino's re-election campaign.

articles.headline: Vozinha's Ballon d'Or night a perfect moment for soccer's dreamers
articles.description: Vozinha's improbable star turn at the 2026 World Cup led him to Monday night's Ballon d'Or ceremony. It was also a perfect moment for those who love the game, but never get love back.

articles.headline: Kane's long road to Ballon d'Or glory ends with his crowning moment
articles.description: After a remarkable year for Bayern Munich and England, Harry Kane becoming the world's best player is the ultimate reward for years of perseverance.
